name: Faramir, Steward of Gondor
oracle_text:
Whenever a legendary creature you control with mana value 4 or greater enters, you become the monarch.
At the beginning of your end step, if you're the monarch, create two 1/1 white Human Soldier creature tokens.
blocked_sentences: Whenever a legendary creature you control with mana value 4 or greater enters, you become the monarch.
At the beginning of your end step, if you're the monarch, create two 1/1 white Human Soldier creature tokens.

needs.what: The monarch designation as game state: at most one player is the monarch at a time, that player draws a card at the beginning of their end step, and a player becomes the monarch whenever a creature they control deals combat damage to the monarch. Needs the designation stored on GameState (a player id or None), those two automatic behaviours wired into the end step and the combat damage step, and a `condition_keys` entry (e.g. `is_monarch`, taking a player selector) so the "if you're the monarch" clause on the end-step trigger can be asked by an `if` op.
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `set_flag`/`has_flag` is the nearest thing and only stores an opaque per-card boolean: it is not exclusive across players, nothing moves it when a creature deals combat damage to its holder, and no end-step draw hangs off it, so a card written on flags would print "you become the monarch" and deliver none of what monarch means. `has_city_s_blessing` is the only designation-shaped condition key and is hard-wired to ascend (ten permanents), not to a transferable player designation. `docs/rules-coverage.md` lists the monarch as not implemented and nothing in `src/` matches /monarch/.

needs.what: An op that makes a player the monarch -- `become_monarch` with a player selector ("you" suffices for this card) -- setting the designation above and firing whatever triggers watch it change.
needs.why_existing_wont_do: No op in `ops` grants a designation. `set_flag` is the closest and writes a card-scoped flag with no game-wide meaning; there is no monarch state for any op to set until the engine need above lands.

needs.what: A token-pool entry for a 1/1 white Human Soldier creature token (both subtypes, e.g. `human_soldier_1_1_w`), plus its registry/art entries, so `create_token` can make the token this card actually prints.
needs.why_existing_wont_do: The pool has `soldier_1_1_w` (Soldier only) and `human_1_1_w` (Human only); each drops one printed subtype, which matters for tribal counts and for other cards' `subtypes` selectors. Existing cards printing this same token (e.g. the enchantment in `data/cards/zurgo.cards.json` whose text reads "create a 1/1 white Human Soldier creature token") already substitute `human_1_1_w`, so the approximation is in the corpus but is still an approximation, not the printed token. Minor next to the monarch blocker and not by itself a reason to hold the card.
